jobs.description:
Job Overview
The Community Manager is the public face of World of Tanks Blitz and a bridge between players, the Community, Publishing and Development teams.
The goal of this role is to build trust with players, maintain an open dialogue with the community, turn player feedback into actionable insights and help the team explain product decisions clearly.
Reports to
Community Team Lead
What will you do?
Manage communication with the RU/UA community across Discord, Telegram, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
Communicate with players online and participate in offline community activities.
Host streams and represent World of Tanks Blitz publicly.
Prepare and publish news, event and update announcements, campaign communications and other content for SM platforms.
Adapt communications to different platforms while maintaining the project’s tone of voice.
Develop engagement activities for the community, including challenges, contests, small events, discussions, Q&As, memes, highlights and UGC formats.
Play WoT Blitz regularly and understand its mechanics, game modes, events, balance, platforms and current versions.
Collect, verify, structure and communicate player feedback to the relevant teams.
Prepare regular community digests for Development and reports upon request.
Participate in content and communication planning.
Attend meetings with Development and Publishing, including balance discussions, to represent players’ needs, expectations and concerns.
Help the team make decisions based on real player experience.
Escalate critical issues and participate in crisis communication processes.
What are we looking for?
Strong knowledge of World of Tanks Blitz and the games industry. Experience with WoT Blitz or WoT PC is a significant advantage.
English at B2 level or higher.
Fluency in Ukrainian and Russian.
Experience working with Discord, Telegram and social media platforms.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence in communicating with an audience and appearing on camera.
Willingness to host streams and act as a public representative of the project.
The ability to analyse player feedback, identify recurring issues and formulate clear insights for the team.
The ability to represent players’ interests while understanding and explaining the business perspective.
Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to change.
It's a good match if you say yes to these points:
easy-going and genuinely enjoy working with people.
open-minded and interested in different opinions and approaches.
independent, proactive and result-oriented.
communicate calmly in difficult or emotional situations.
not conflict-driven, but can clearly explain and defend a position.
flexible and open to learning new tools and formats.
reliable team player who cares about both the result and the process.
truly interested in the project and want to develop it together with the community.
Work mode
Hybrid (2-3 days of work from the office)
This role isn't eligible for relocation & immigration support.
The salary range for this role in Vilnius is EUR 3000-3800 monthly gross.
Benefits
Benefits and perks are tailored to the local market and culture. Our benefits in Vilnius include:
Additional paid time off
Sick Leave Compensation
Pregnancy and Childbirth Leave Benefit
Career development and education opportunities within the company
Meal Allowance
Premium Private Health Care
Mental well-being program (iFeel)
Perks discounts platform (over 450 exclusive discounts)
Personal Gaming Account
Coffee, fruits, and snacks in the office
Company events
Seniority Awards
Referral program - You can recommend the best talents to the company and receive a reward
Please submit your CV in English to ensure smooth processing and review.
About Wargaming
Wargaming is an award-winning online game developer and publisher headquartered in Nicosia, Cyprus. Operating since 1998, Wargaming has become one of the leaders in the gaming industry with 15 offices worldwide, including studios in Chicago, Prague, Shanghai, Tokyo, and Vilnius. Our diverse and multicultural team works together to deliver a top-class experience to millions of players who enjoy Wargaming's titles across all major gaming platforms. Our flagship products include free-to-play hits World of Tanks, World of Warships and World of Tanks Blitz.

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title
League of Legends
to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the
League of Legends
experience.
We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.
That's where you come in.
As a
Program Manager
on the VALORANT Mobile team, you will help the team operate more effectively across Riot partners and external development partners. This role is centered on program leadership rather than direct feature review or product ownership.
You will improve the systems, operating rhythms, and collaboration models that help VALORANT Mobile move with greater clarity, predictability, and efficiency. You will be a force multiplier for the broader product team by helping leaders and partners prioritize work, facilitate alignment, identify the right stakeholders, and define actionable next steps in ambiguous cross-functional spaces.
A key part of this role will be partnering closely with Riot stakeholders to improve our greenlight process for feature and content development, enabling both sides to work with stronger transparency, clearer ownership, and more efficient decision-making.
You will report to the Product Lead of VALORANT Mobile.
Responsibilities:
Help the VALORANT Mobile product team prioritize complex work across multiple initiatives, functions, and partner teams by creating clarity on goals, trade-offs, ownership, and actionable next steps
Facilitate alignment across Riot and external stakeholders by identifying the right decision-makers, driving discussions to clear outcomes, and helping the team navigate complex cross-functional dependencies and escalation paths
Help reshape the current greenlight process across different types of features and content for VALORANT Mobile, to evolve the steps, methods, and collaboration model as the game, its operating needs, and its stakeholder landscape continue to change post-launch
Drive cross-functional coordination for regular patches and major moments, ensuring teams stay aligned on scope, timing, dependencies, and readiness
Build and maintain strong operating systems, including trackers, planning rituals, decision logs, communication loops, and escalation paths that improve team visibility, accountability, and follow-through
Proactively identify risks, blockers, and dependency gaps early, then work with partners to resolve issues and keep strategically important work moving
Build effective working relationships across Riot and external partners, while communicating priorities, status, risks, and decisions clearly to leadership and stakeholders over time
Required Qualifications:
6+ years of experience in program management, project management, production, operations, or a related role in game development, live services, or similarly cross-functional environments
Demonstrated experience driving high-complexity, strategically important cross-functional programs from planning through execution
Strong prioritization and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguity, competing goals, and incomplete information into clear action plans
Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience guiding teams toward decisions and alignment across complex or contentious spaces
Experience building or improving processes, planning rituals, and workflow systems that increase transparency, predictability, and execution quality
Experience working with distributed teams and external or co-development partners across different cultures, incentives, and working styles
Proven ability to identify risks early, manage dependencies, and drive mitigation plans across multiple workstreams
Strong documentation and operational tool fluency, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, Slides, Airtable, Jira, Trello, or similar systems
Fluency in both English and Mandarin
Desired Qualifications:
Experience working on tactical shooters, competitive multiplayer games, or mobile live service products
Experience improving approval workflows, collaboration models, or operating processes across internal and external teams
Experience working in a large, matrixed, and globally distributed organization
Familiarity with live game development rhythms such as patch planning, release readiness, seasonal beats, and ongoing cross-team execution support
Passion for VALORANT and strong instincts for how to help teams work effectively in service of a great player experience
For this role, you’ll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players.
Riot Games 成立于 2006 年，由一群坚信“以玩家为中心的开发理念可以带来真正伟大游戏”的玩家所创立。2020 年，Riot 正式推出 VALORANT，为战术竞技射击品类树立了新的标杆。随着 VALORANT 持续拓展至更多平台，VALORANT Mobile 将承担把这种高强度、高精度的竞技体验带给更多全球玩家的重要使命。
我们正在寻找兼具谦逊心态、进取精神与优秀判断力的伙伴。你愿意带来自己的经验与观点，也乐于在高标准环境中不断学习和打磨。你相信，优秀的执行并不只来自个人能力，更来自清晰的决策机制、健康的团队运转，以及高质量的跨团队合作。
这就是你登场的舞台。
作为 VALORANT Mobile 团队的项目经理，你将帮助团队在 Riot 内部合作方与外部联合研发伙伴之间建立更高效的协作方式。这个职位的核心并不是直接负责功能评审或产品 owner 工作，而是通过 program leadership 提升团队整体运转效率。
你将负责优化团队的工作机制、协作节奏与跨团队推进方式，帮助 VALORANT Mobile 在复杂环境下更清晰、更可预测、更高效地推进关键事项。你会成为整个产品团队的放大器，帮助团队完成优先级判断、推动对齐、识别正确的相关方，并在模糊且跨职能的问题空间中定义明确、可执行的下一步。
这个职位的关键职责之一，是与Riot 各方伙伴紧密合作，持续优化 feature 与 content 的 greenlight process，让双方在透明度、责任归属与决策效率上都达到更高标准。
你将汇报给 VALORANT Mobile 的 Product Lead。
职责描述
帮助 VALORANT Mobile 产品团队在多个项目、多个职能与多个合作团队之间，对复杂事项进行优先级排序，明确目标、取舍、负责人以及可执行的后续行动
推动 Riot 内外部相关方达成一致，识别正确的决策相关方，推动讨论形成清晰结论，并帮助团队处理复杂的跨团队依赖与升级路径
帮助重塑 VALORANT Mobile 针对不同类型功能与内容的现有 greenlight 流程，随着游戏进入上线后新阶段、运营需求持续演变以及相关方结构发生变化，不断优化 greenlight 的步骤、方法与整体协作模式
推动常规版本与重要版本节点的跨团队协调，确保各团队在范围、节奏、依赖关系与就绪度上保持一致
建立并维护清晰有效的团队运转机制，包括追踪表、规划节奏、决策记录、沟通节奏与升级路径，提升团队整体可见性、责任感与执行跟进质量
提前识别风险、阻塞与依赖缺口，并联合相关团队推动问题解决，确保战略重要事项持续前进
与 Riot及外部合作方建立高质量合作关系，并持续以清晰方式向管理层与相关方同步优先级、状态、风险与关键决策
基本要求
6 年以上项目管理、项目推进、制作、运营，或其他相关岗位经验，具备游戏研发、长线运营或类似复杂跨职能环境中的工作背景
有推动高复杂度、战略优先级高的跨团队项目从规划到落地的实际经验
具备很强的优先级判断与问题拆解能力，能够把模糊信息、冲突目标与不完整输入转化为清晰的行动方案
具备优秀的会议引导、沟通与相关方管理能力，能够在复杂或存在争议的场景中推动团队做出决策并达成一致
有建立或优化流程、计划机制与协作系统的经验，能够有效提升透明度、可预测性与执行质量
有与分布式团队、外部团队或联合研发伙伴合作的经验，能够适应不同文化背景、激励机制与工作方式
能够提前识别风险、管理依赖关系，并推动跨工作流的风险缓解方案
具备良好的文档与运营工具使用能力，包括 Google Docs、Google Sheets、Slides、Airtable、Jira、Trello 或类似工具
中英文流利，能够支持本地与全球团队协作
加分项
有战术射击、竞技多人游戏或移动端长线运营产品相关经验
有优化审批流程、跨团队协作模型或团队运转流程的经验
有在大型矩阵式、全球分布式组织中工作的经验
熟悉长线运营游戏开发的核心节奏，例如版本规划、上线准备、赛季节奏与持续性的跨团队推进
热爱 VALORANT，并对如何通过更好的团队协作来服务玩家体验有较强直觉
这个职位的成功，来自于你扎实的专业能力、合作意识，以及始终把玩家体验放在重要位置的判断方式。

jobs.description: Summary: This role builds and supports the data models, dashboards, pipelines, and reports the Technology Financial Operations Office uses to manage technology cost, Cloud FinOps, TCO, portfolio, demand, and productivity information. The work is to move recurring reporting off manual spreadsheets and one-off files and onto governed analytics products with reliable refreshes, consistent definitions, and clear ownership. Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric are the corporate platforms for this work; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered. The test of success is whether leadership uses the reporting as delivered, without rebuilding it in a spreadsheet first and without the numbers falling apart when someone checks them. Who We Are Looking For The Technology Financial Operations Office is looking for a hands-on Data Analytics & BI Engineer to be based in Dublin. The broader team is distributed, with several senior stakeholders and complementary roles based in other offices, so this role will need to partner effectively across locations. This is a build-and-support role: the successful candidate does the BI engineering and data modeling directly, works with the stakeholders who use the output, and stays with those products once they are in production. The work runs the full path from a loosely defined reporting request through discovery, data preparation, modeling, build, validation, release, and ongoing support. It suits someone comfortable with both technical partners and non-technical business users, who can explain what a number means as readily as they can build the model behind it. The role is judged on what reaches production and gets used, not on the volume of reports produced. Why This Role Is Important to Us The Technology Financial Operations Office is moving recurring reporting off manually maintained spreadsheets and one-off files and onto BI products that can be reused across functions. Source data is fragmented across finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, and service management systems, and the questions leadership asks keep changing as the cost agenda matures. This role makes the answers reliable enough to act on without side calculations or manual reconciliation. Near-term work includes reporting for IT Total Cost of Ownership and showback, Cloud FinOps spend and optimization tracking, productivity and demand reporting, and the retirement of high-effort manual reports. These are starting points rather than the boundary of the role; the same discipline will be applied to further cost and financial analytics products as the Business Office defines them. What You Will Be Responsible For Build and maintain data pipelines, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and refreshable reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related analytics tools. Modernize spreadsheet-based reporting by converting recurring, manually maintained reports into governed, reusable BI products with defined owners and a support model. Develop reporting that supports technology financial management, IT Total Cost of Ownership, Cloud FinOps, portfolio, demand, and headcount processes, including showback views and optimization tracking. Prepare, reconcile, and model data from finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, headcount, and service management systems, including the transformation logic and refresh processes that keep those sources aligned. Build reusable datasets, semantic models, and measures, together with the validation checks and exception reporting that surface data quality issues before they reach a report. Design dashboards and reports that Business Office teams, finance partners, and senior technology leaders can read and act on without a walkthrough. Work directly with business stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results, translating loosely defined questions into something the available data can answer. Apply controlled release, change, and access practices so reporting stays secure, traceable, and safe to change once it is in production. Document sources, definitions, assumptions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations. Support delivered products after launch, including issue intake, triage, resolution, and continuous improvement. What We Value The following skills and qualities matter most in this role: Ownership of a vague reporting request from discovery through build, validation, release, and ongoing support, including the unglamorous parts, without needing to be chased. Comfort working with imperfect source data, and the discipline to reconcile differences, document assumptions, and state plainly what the data will and will not support. A clear line between actuals, forecasts, estimates, and advisory analysis, held consistently and without turning every number into a caveat. The ability to explain a number, its limitations, and the tradeoffs behind it to a finance partner, a technical peer, or a senior executive. Comfort working across functions where definitions, source data, and ownership are still maturing, and the patience to build alignment rather than wait for it. A product mindset that treats reporting as a supported capability with an owner, a backlog, and a roadmap rather than a series of one-off builds. Exacting standards for documentation, data quality, governance, and auditability, because these reports are relied on every month and are expected to hold up to review. Hands-on experience building BI solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric preferred, including Power Query, DAX, semantic models, dashboards, dataflows, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, and SQL; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered. Demonstrated experience building data models, measures, reconciliations, and refresh processes that span multiple source systems and survive routine change in those sources. Familiarity with financial, portfolio, procurement, cloud, and headcount data, and with IT cost transparency concepts such as Total Cost of Ownership, showback, and Cloud FinOps, preferred. Experience documenting data lineage, definitions, calculations, and controls in a governed or regulated enterprise environment preferred. Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results before release preferred. Additional Requirements This is a matrixed role. The work spans finance, FinOps, portfolio, procurement, and technology teams, with requirements that shift as the cost agenda matures and source data that rarely arrives clean. Comfort operating with that level of ambiguity, and the persistence to resolve it rather than route around it, matters as much as technical skill. Standard business hours, with flexibility as needed to support stakeholders across time zones; limited travel may be required. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the Role
Claude has your back. AIRE has Claude's. Help us keep Claude reliable for everyone who depends on it.
AIRE (AI Reliability Engineering) partners with teams across Anthropic to improve reliability across our most critical serving paths -- every hop from the SDK through our network, API layers, serving infrastructure, and accelerators and back. We jump into the trenches alongside partner teams to make the systems that deliver Claude more robust and resilient, be it during an incident or collaborating on projects.
Reliability here is an emergent phenomenon that transcends any single team's boundaries, so someone has to zoom out and look at the whole picture. That's us -- and it means few teams at Anthropic offer this kind of dynamic, cross-cutting exposure to the systems that matter most.
Responsibilities
Develop appropriate Service Level Objectives for large language model serving systems, balancing availability and latency with development velocity.
Design and implement monitoring and observability systems across the token path.
Assist in the design and implementation of high-availability serving infrastructure across multiple regions and cloud providers
Lead incident response for critical AI services, ensuring rapid recovery, thorough incident reviews, and systematic improvements.
Support the reliability of safeguard model serving -- critical for both site reliability and Anthropic's safety commitments.
You may be a good fit if you
Have strong distributed systems, infrastructure, or reliability backgrounds -- we're looking for reliability-minded software engineers and SREs.
Are curious and brave -- comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems during an incident and helping drive resolution even when you don't have deep expertise yet.
Think holistically about how systems compose and where the seams are.
Can build lasting relationships across teams -- our engagement model depends on being welcomed as teammates, not outsiders with opinions.
Care about users and feel ownership over outcomes, even for systems you don't own.
Have excellent communication and collaboration skills -- you'll be partnering across the entire company.
Bring diverse experience -- the team's strength comes from people who've built product stacks, scaled databases, run massive distributed systems, and everything in between.
Strong candidates may also
Have been an SRE, Production Engineer, or in similar reliability-focused roles on large scale systems
Have experience operating large-scale model serving or training infrastructure (>1000 GPUs).
Have experience with one or more ML hardware accelerators (GPUs, TPUs, Trainium).
Understand ML-specific networking optimizations like RDMA and InfiniBand.
Have expertise in AI-specific observability tools and frameworks.
Have experience with chaos engineering and systematic resilience testing.
Have contributed to open-source infrastructure or ML tooling.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
